insert into pet_orders
order_no, order_status, order_time, user_id, shop_id, pet_id, pet_name, pet_img, pet_price, address_id, consignee, phone_number, province_code, city_code, district_code, detail_address,
#{orderNo}, #{orderStatus}, #{orderTime}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{petId}, #{petName}, #{petImg}, #{petPrice}, #{addressId}, #{consignee}, #{phoneNumber}, #{provinceCode}, #{cityCode}, #{districtCode}, #{detailAddress},
mapper.select: select id, order_no, order_status, order_time, user_id, shop_id, pet_id, pet_name, pet_img, pet_price, address_id, consignee, phone_number, province_code, city_code, district_code, detail_address from pet_orders where order_no = #{orderNo}

select po.order_no, po.order_status, po.order_time, po.shop_id, po.pet_id, po.pet_name, po.pet_img, po.pet_price, ps.nickname as shopName from pet_orders po left join pet_shop ps on po.shop_id = ps.id where po.user_id = #{userId} order by po.order_time desc
select coalesce(sum(pet_price), 0) from pet_orders where order_status != 5
select ps.nickname as shopName, coalesce(sum(po.pet_price), 0) as amount from pet_orders po left join pet_shop ps on po.shop_id = ps.id where po.order_status != 5 group by po.shop_id

select status_list.status, coalesce(count(po.id), 0) as count, coalesce(sum(po.pet_price), 0) as amount from (select 0 as status union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5) as status_list left join pet_orders po on status_list.status = po.order_status and po.shop_id = #{shopId} and date(po.order_time) = curdate() group by status_list.status order by status_list.status;
